caption: The drawing depicts the back view of an elaborate dress on a plain, off-white background. The dress is predominantly a pale green color with a delicate, intricate floral pattern throughout. The fitted bodice extends smoothly into a long, trailing skirt that spreads out on the floor, and the edges of the skirt are trimmed with a ruffled pink border. Soft pink fabric drapes from both sides of the waist and is gathered by the hands positioned at the hips, adding volume and contrast to the green main garment. There is a small blue-green accent or pouch at the right side of the waist. The dress has long sleeves and a high collar, which is also edged in pink ruffles. No head, feet, or additional accessories are visible in the image.
title: Dress
